text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
“—And so! The ‘Curren Chan Fan Meeting★
Christmas Special’ is about to start~!”

text_block_list.name: Curren's Fans
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaaaah~!
Curren~!!
――It all started a few hours ago.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! You know how Curren was nominated
for Umastagram's 'Trend of the Year' category
the other day?
I definitely remember seeing that on her posts. If I recall, it's an award given to the most talked-about person on UmaStagram that year...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: And as part of the celebration, I want to thank the fans in person!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Because if no one was paying attention to Curren,
she wouldn't have been nominated, right?"

Considering how much she cares for her fans, it might make for a nice breather.
With that in mind, just as we were about to set a schedule—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Well then, shall we go, Onii-chan?
Looks like quite a few fans have already gathered.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Well then, shall we go, Onee-chan?
Looks like quite a few fans have already gathered.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to open up the cafeteria a little early,
so I'd love it if you could lend a quick hand!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yeah!
choice_data_list: Still, the application to the academy...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's already done~.
The academy application, the announcements, all the arrangements, and reserving the cafeteria—all set!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I promoted it pretty well with short videos on Umastagram and stuff, but...
Onii-chan, you haven't checked them, have you~?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I promoted it pretty well with short videos on Umastagram and stuff, but...
Onee-chan, you haven't checked them, have you~?

I hadn't noticed at all...
Just as I was reflecting on my failure
to help her with anything—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Actually, Big Brother, I've got an important role prepared for you.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Actually, Big Sister, I've got an important role prepared for you.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
That・is~... keep your eyes on Curren having fun and don't look away for a second!
I'm counting on you, Onii-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
That・is~... keep your eyes on Curren having fun and don't look away for a second!
I'm counting on you, Onee-chan♪

And so, the fan meeting began.
As instructed, I watched over Curren Chan as she interacted with the fans who had packed the venue.

text_block_list.name: Curren's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, um!
C-Congratulations on your nomination!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you♪
It's all thanks to everyone~!

text_block_list.name: Curren's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Wow, Curren in real life is crazy cute!
Like, super, seriously cute!

text_block_list.name: Curren's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"We just became fans recently...
We love racing, so we can't wait to watch you run!
We're rooting for you!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you~♪
With everyone's cheers,
Curren can run anywhere and everywhere♪

text_block_list.name: Curren's Fans
text_block_list.text:
So cuuuute!!
I'll follow you to the ends of the earth~~~!!

"Thanks in part to the PR efforts, she seems to have gained new fans.
Looks like we've achieved our initial goal of boosting visibility."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, everyone~!
Bye-byyyye!

text_block_list.name: Curren's Fans
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaa~~!
Bye-byeee!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...Phew~ Was that the last group?
I'm so glad I got to chat with everyone so much♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Well then, time to clean up—

text_block_list.name: Curren's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Hey, is that girl over there
the one who won this year's Oaks...?

text_block_list.name: Curren's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Huh?!
Ah?! Y-You're right...!

text_block_list.name: Curren's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Um, I watched all your races!
I was so deeply moved...!

text_block_list.name: Oaks Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Huh? Um... thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Curren's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
It's a shame about the Triple Tiara, but...
Still, she was so strong, so cool...
*sniff*

text_block_list.name: Curren's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I'm so happy to meet the real you...! 
You were so, so cool...!

text_block_list.name: Oaks Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much.
I'll do my best in the upcoming Arima Kinen too,
so please cheer for me again if you'd like!

text_block_list.name: Curren's Fans
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'm really looking forward to seeing you on a big stage again~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...In the end, it's all about the race, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
The power of racing is truly amazing.
Curren thinks she understands how those kids felt just now, just a little bit.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
A brilliance so immense...
can't help but dazzle the eyes.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Onii-chan.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Sis.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren, after all...
really wants the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Let's settle this once and for all.
Is Curren truly worthy of the Tiara, or...

I was met with a serious gaze.
Even at this stage with all the training under my belt,
it's still going to be tough... But still.

If she's truly determined to take on the challenge,
then as her Trainer, I must watch over her to the very end!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you
for letting Curren take on this challenge.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
The first Oka Sho was 1,600m, right?
Curren's aptitude is 1,200m, so that means—
choice_data_list: We should start by taking on the 1,400m.
You should start by taking on the 1,400m.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yeah, Curren thinks so too!
choice_data_list: Then, let's take on the Fillies' Revue.

text_block_list.text:
"If she can run well in this race,
she might get one step closer to that seemingly impossible dream of tackling the Triple Tiara!"
choice_data_list: Still, if it turns out to be impossible, then—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I know, Big Brother.
...Feel free to be strict with me, okay?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I know, Big Sister.
...Feel free to be strict with me, okay?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Still, Curren doesn't think it's impossible.
I'll definitely prove I can clear it!
And so, the next goal was set: the Fillies' Revue!
